things-owner.title: Point out things and owners
things-owner.bodyMarkdown:
**Jan:** Mari, liv sa a se pou ou.

**Mari:** Mèsi, Jan. Kaye sa yo se pou ou.

**Jan:** Mèsi.

Now listen to those same words inside a real exchange.

actions-and-questions.title: Ask, answer, return
actions-and-questions.bodyMarkdown:
**Mari:** Jan, kisa ou ap fè?

**Jan:** M ap etidye kreyòl. E ou menm?

**Mari:** M ap travay kounyeya.

The response connects directly to the previous turn.

quantity-and-time.title: Ask for practical details
quantity-and-time.bodyMarkdown:
**Jan:** Konbyen liv ou genyen?

**Mari:** Mwen genyen twa liv.

**Mari:** Akilè ou etidye kreyòl?

**Jan:** Senkè edmi. Mwen etidye kreyòl aswè.

Numbers and time now work inside a conversation instead of as isolated vocabulary.
